name: How should I choose a contractor for barndominium shell construction?
description: Look for a licensed general contractor with dedicated structural shell experience, clear engineering deliverables, and familiarity with regional building codes.

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a contractor for barndominium shell construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: When evaluating a shell contractor, verify their licensing as a general contractor, experience with pre-engineered steel or post-frame buildings, and familiarity with local permitting authorities. Ask what specific components are included in the shell contract, such as foundation work, framing, and insulation packages. A clear contract should detail structural engineering inclusions, warranty terms, and handover conditions before you commit.
